figurative_meaning_bn: নবাবের মত আচার আচরণ, অনুকরণপ্রিয়তা; নবাবসূলভ বড়মানুষি
figurative_meaning_en: Behavior like a Nawab, pretentious imitation; grandiosity typical of a Nawab
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নবাবী চাল করে সকলের সামনে বড়াই করে।
অত নবাবী চাল করলে কেউ তোমাকে পছন্দ করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He puts on a nawabi style and boasts in front of everyone.
If you act so pretentiously like a Nawab, no one will like you.
history: Refers to the opulent and aristocratic lifestyle of Nawabs, historical Muslim rulers in Bengal during the Mughal and early British eras, often critiquing modern pretensions mimicking that era.
note: The idiom highlights class distinctions in Bengali society.
